svg.title: Rioja study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Rioja; 2: Haro; 3: Logroño; 4: Cenicero; 5: Fuenmayor; 6: San Vicente de la Sonsierra; 7: Laguardia; 8: Elciego; 9: Alfaro; 10: Calahorra; 11: Cihuri; 12: Granjafría

g.title: 6 · San Vicente de la Sonsierra: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
